author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We've seen a few original Batman costumes before, but none from Christopher Nolan's Dark Knight Trilogy. Adam takes a look at Batman's cowl from Batman Begins, alongside Bane's mask from The Dark Knight Rises. Plus, two memorable and beautifully crafted blaster props the Batman universe: Batman's EMP rifle and Mr. Freeze's ice cannon!

Propstore's Entertainment Memorabilia Live Auction is happening this week and you can follow along here: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/496

Learn more about this props and see more details at: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/catalog/id/496
